notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.58 — Sign check: each candidate awaiting contract signature now displays their saved mobile number, a one-click Copy number button, a concise personalised contract follow-up message, and buttons to Copy message, open the candidate's existing Phone Link / SMS conversation, or open their existing WhatsApp chat. WhatsApp prefers the installed Windows desktop app and safely falls back to a browser chat; it does not pre-fill/send messages. Added Copy text to the compact candidate row so reminders can be copied without expanding every person. UK mobile formats 07, +44, 447 and 0044 are normalised for WhatsApp. Missing/invalid WhatsApp numbers disable that shortcut rather than opening the wrong chat. Copying text or opening Phone Link/WhatsApp never marks the contract signed, marks a reminder sent, or changes Pipeline checkboxes/timers. All existing local candidate progress, official MBL integration, and the v1.1.57 historical induction fix are retained. Two-device automatic cloud sync remains under development and is NOT enabled. The integrated release checks also verify the new messaging helper loads in the correct script order.
